summary: Five design decisions put to the human one at a time, each led by a recommendation; all five confirmed as recommended. Facts (file:line for the write-permission conflict, the completion predicate, the missing prompt wiring, and the installed Codex skills) were looked up in two read-only audits and verified directly, not asked.
gaps: The plan initially had no answer for a worker that genuinely finishes part of a task: every signal kind presumes it wants to continue.
Enforcing runnable verify_commands would break real projects whose active decompositions already carry prose (agentstats: 'package test script').
stage done measuring the diff needed a base to measure from; stages carried no base commit.
A brief recorded once could drift from the file actually handed to the executor.
contradictions: The plan's own gate (a hook denial on unbriefed --write) contradicts decision 0011's separation only in appearance: 0011 governs review ownership, not delegation, and no reviewer is being nested. Checked against every active decision; no other conflict found.
forge codex status reads a third-party plugin path, which conflicts with decision 0001's determinism contract if it could gate a ship.
resolutions: Added stage done --incomplete '<what is missing>': the stage stays open, the gap lands in the events ledger, and forge next surfaces it.
Migration is explicit: the recorder refuses prose only for NEW decompositions; shipped history is untouched and forge doctor reports any active decomposition still carrying prose.
stage start records the base commit on the stage, so stage done measures against a fixed point rather than a guess.
The delegation record stores brief_sha256; the hook re-digests the file on disk, so an edited brief invalidates the delegation.
forge codex status is declared advisory in the enforcement matrix — a diagnostic reading a third-party path must never be able to block a ship.
Every rule in the plan is listed in an enforcement matrix naming the script that refuses; nothing in it relies on an agent following an instruction.
open_items: Rendering delegation state on the board is deferred to the display-layer work still outstanding from PR #24. Non-blocking: the CLI surfaces it this round.
docs/decisions/0018-delegation-gates.md is recorded as proposed. Acceptance is human chat confirmation, not an implementation step.
